The user asks for a pre-delivery review: check for errors, unsupported authority, anything that doesn't reconcile. Fix what's found and list changes.

Let me do a thorough review pass:

1. **Re-read all four deliverable files completely** — look for internal inconsistencies, unsupported claims, numbers that don't reconcile.
2. **Cross-check claims against the library** (sole citable authority) — every legal assertion must trace to library texts.
3. **Cross-check against evidence documents** — dates, quotes.
4. **Arithmetic re-verification.**

Key things to scrutinize from prior work:
- The "~47 dias" imediatidade claim: 21/08/2026 (Renata knew) → 07/10/2026 (provoked RH). Let me compute: Aug 21 → Oct 7. Aug: 21→31 = 10 days; Sep: 30 days; Oct: 7 days. Total = 47 days. OK.
- "11/10/2026" dispensa presumida — pedido_rh date.
- Estabilidade cipeira "até ~02/06/2028"? Let me check: eleita suplente 12/05/2026, posse 02/06/2026, mandato 1 ano → mandato ends ~02/06/2027; ADCT 10 II "a": registro da candidatura → 1 ano APÓS o mandato. So guarantee extends to ~02/06/2028. That was in prior context as "est. cipeira até ~02/06/2028". Need to check what the parecer says — §4.3 (cipeira section) — verify the dates stated there reconcile.
- Gestante: confirmação 18/09/2026 (atestado entregue; registro no ambulatório). ADCT 10 II "b": desde confirmação até 5 meses após parto. DPP ~23/04/2027 estimada → +5 meses ≈ 23/09/2027. Prior summary says "gestante até ~22/09/2027 (DPP ~23/04/2027 estimada)". Hmm — 23/04/2027 + 5 months = 23/09/2027, but summary says até ~22/09/2027. Slight discrepancy — need to check what the file actually states and whether it's internally consistent.
- The 153.920,00 indenização: 19 × 7.800,00 = 148.200,00; 22 × 260,00 = 5.720,00 → 153.920,00. Wait — salário-dia 260? 7800/30 = 260. OK. 148.200 + 5.720 = 153.920. ✓. But 19 salaries + 22 days — what period does that represent? Cipeira + gestante overlapping? This is pre-existing arithmetic from §5.2 that presumably was verified earlier. Need to re-read §5.2 to check the period logic: from dispensa 11/10/2026 to end of gestante guarantee ~22/09/2027 ≈ 11.4 months... Hmm, 19 × salary is 19 months — that seems long. Let me actually read the section. Maybe it's months of estabilidade covered within salários +... Actually "salários e direitos do período" (Súmula 244 II). From ~11/10/2026 to ~22/09/2027 is ~11.5 months, not 19. But maybe the guarantee periods are computed differently — cipeira até 02/06/2028 is 19.7 months from 11/10/2026! 11/10/2026 → 02/06/2028 = 19.7 months ≈ 19 months + 22 days. That matches: 19 × full salary + 22 × salário-dia. So §5.2 likely uses the cipeira guarantee as the longest (até ~02/06/2028): from 11/10/2026 to 02/06/2028 = 19 months and 22 days. Check: 11/10/2026 + 19 months = 11/05/2028; + 22 days = 03/06/2028? Hmm, 11/05/2028 + 22 days = 02/06/2028. Yes! Exactly. So 19 months 22 days from 11/10/2026 = 02/06/2028. That reconciles beautifully. The 153.920,00 = salários do período de estabilidade (using the longer cipeira window, since both guarantees overlap; gestante guarantee ends earlier? no wait — gestante até ~22/09/2027 is shorter than cipeira até 02/06/2028). OK.
- 44.406,27 verbas rescisórias: aviso + 13º + férias etc. for ~5.6 years of tenure (15/03/2021 → 11/10/2026). Pre-existing; was verified earlier.
- Question: does §5.2's use of the cipeira period for "indenizacao_estabilidade" get properly labeled? Need to read.

Other things to check:
- **§10 item 3 claim**: "manter o contrato custa R$ 0 de exposição" — is that supported? It's an economic comparison, fine.
- "**~R$ 213.326,27**" in §1 matches JSON.
- The STATUS.md line "até ~R$ 218.326,27" — uses ~ for a precise number; minor stylistic, not an error.
- QUESTIONS.md note references.
- Check "imedia*" — done, fine.
- Check for any place where we wrote "difamação ... não verificado" but the library has relevant material? The library note covers "crítica genérica... sem imputação falsa de crime" — labels imprecisão? We said conceitos de difamação/calúnia penal ou civil não constam da biblioteca — correct.
- One potential issue: in §10 item 3, "**Grávida com justa causa perde a estabilidade, eu li isso**" — quote includes "eu li isso" inside quotes — verbatim ✓.
- Check the cronologia row: "25/10/2026 (complemento)" — the instruction message came same date. ✓.
- Now the **harder check: unsupported authority**. Scan the deliverables for any legal citation NOT in the library. E.g., "CLT 165 par. único" — in library estabilidade_cipa ✓. "Súmula 244 I/II" — in estabilidade_gestante ✓. "Súmula 339 I" (suplente) ✓. "ADCT 10 II a/b" ✓. "CLT 482 k" ✓. "CLT 493" (perdão tácito? actually imediatidade is 452/493?) — library clt_482_493 cites arts. 482, 493 — 493 is the justa causa for qualificação... The parecer attr. perdão tácito to "CLT art. 493 e jurisprudência do TST" — library says "imediatidade/atualidade — a punição deve seguir-se ao conhecimento da falta... sob pena de perdão tácito" with "Citation: CLT arts. 482, 493". OK supported.
- "Divisor mensal de 220h: prática usual, não constante da biblioteca — não verificado" — properly flagged.
- "multa de 40% do FGTS" in §5.7 (hours conversion) — hmm! Wait. In §5.7, the aux scenario converts hours into "horas extras + reflexos" and applies "FGTS 8% + multa de 40% do FGTS" — is the 40% FGTS fine supported by the library? The verbas_reversao file mentions "multa 40% FGTS" for rescisória. Applying 8%/40% to converted overtime payment is a real-world accuracy question — the library says reflexos em 13º/férias não calculados and the whole §5.7 is labeled ilustrativa/not verificado (regras do banco). But the 11.2% encargo statement — is "≈11,2% do principal" (8% + 40%×8% = 8%+3.2% = 11.2%) supported? It's arithmetic on library rules (FGTS 8% on remuneração + multa 40% sobre FGTS). Whether overtime credits would attract FGTS in reality — plausible, marked ilustrativo. It's within the aux block that's flagged NÃO incluída nos totais. I think acceptable; maybe ensure the §5.7 text marks it illustrative — it does ("Horas extras + reflexos", "ilustrativa").
- Check JSON "exposicao_acessoria_banco_de_horas" - labelled ilustrativa. ✓.
- **Check STATUS/QUESTIONS/JSON/md mutual consistency of numbers**: 213.326,27; 198.326,27; 203.326,27–218.326,27; 44.406,27; 153.920,00; 10.400,00 (férias open item); 4.888,76; 1.222,19; 5–20 mil; 15.000.
- Potential reconciliation issue: QUESTIONS.md says "quantificação ilustrativa em parecer.md §5.7" ✓.
- STATUS artefatos lines — check they match final content (already edited).
- **One more potential inconsistency**: the summary says STATUS has "conclusão executiva" — need to re-read full STATUS.
- Also potential issue in previous session's md edit E5: line 156 now reads "...(§10, itens 1–2); a instrução da gerente que se seguiu no mesmo registro (§10, item 3)..." — wait, in the latest grep output line 156 shows: "Foram confirmados apenas o registro obstétrico de 18/09/2026 e o crédito das 62h ao banco de horas (§10, itens 1–2); a instrução da gerente que se seguiu no mesmo registro (§10, item 3) tampouco esclarece nenhum destes itens." — good.
- Hmm wait, actually the earlier grep (before my error-review) showed line 156 as: "...62h ao banco de horas (§10, itens 1–2); a instrução da gerente que se seguiu no mesmo registro (§10, item 3)..." — hmm, that grep output showed "a instrução da gerente que se seguiu" — fine.
- Residual '197' scan in md/st/ques (we only scanned raw JSON). Search all files for '197'.
- Also scan for other stale numbers: '193326', '200326' etc. — just search '197' and maybe any '1.126.930' variants? Prior summary mentioned earlier draft had different totals at some point (e.g., 261.930,79 mentioned as "est. acessória ampliado" — that's the N2 open item in QUESTIONS presumably; check).
- Wait, open item N2: "acessórios de estabilidade, ~261.930,79 ampliado" — hmm that was in QUESTIONS/STATUS as an open item presumably. Fine.

Also check: **the 47-day claim** — recompute precisely: 21/08 → 07/10. Days between: Aug 21→31: 10; +30 (Sep) = 40; +7 = 47. ✓ "≈ 47 dias".

**DPP estimation**: where does DPP ~23/04/2027 come from? Impossible to verify medically — but presumably the file labels it "estimada". Check what §4 says. Also "gestante até ~22/09/2027" vs 5 months after 23/04/2027 = 23/09/2027. If the file says 22/09 it's off by a day, or says ~22/09 based on... hmm. Whatever the file says, check consistency. Actually from the earlier read, the open item table says "fim da garantia gestante (~22/09/2027 estimado)". And the cipeira end date "~02/06/2028"? Not shown in the lines read. Need to grep for '2028' and '22/09' and '23/04'.

Also check §5.2's narrative: "19 × 7.800,00 = 148.200,00; 22 × 260,00 = 5.720,00 → R$ 153.920,00" — and that the section explains it's salários do período da estabilidade (longest guarantee, cipeira até ~02/06/2028). If the "indenizacao_estabilidade" is based on the cipeira period but the section label says estabilidade generally — fine as both guarantees run; you'd pay salários until the LATER end. Also should note gestante's salários are covered within the same period since it's shorter. OK.

Also possible issue: **"R$ 0 caso mantenha contrato"** phrasing appears in several places.

Also confirm there's no place claiming ADCT 10 II "b" "veda dispensa arbitrária **ou** sem justa causa". Library exact text: "vedada dispensa arbitrária **ou sem justa causa**" per summary. Our text says "veda a dispensa **arbitrária ou sem justa causa**". ✓.

Now also verify there are no **COPY-leftover** duplicated edits (e.g., two cronologia rows for 25/10?). The cronologia row edit appended after the existing 25/10/2026 row. Need to ensure no duplication occurred (edit replaced the row with row+new row). ✓ one replacement.

Also check for any double "Instrução da gerente" sections in STATUS.

Also possible issue: **md line numbers** in the previous read of lines 179-201 show §10 item 3 present and formatting fine.

Also check the md header line 3 for "respostas da cliente e instrução da gerente incorporadas — seção 10" ✓ (from E1).

Plan:
1. Full re-read of all 4 deliverables (md ~201+ lines total? Actually md is 201+... let me read full); JSON full; QUESTIONS full; STATUS full.
2. Re-scan library files quickly if any citation doubt.
3. Python arithmetic re-check including new: 47-day diff, 19 months +22 days period check, 148.200+5.720, aviso/13º/férias components of 44.406,27 (need to see §5.1 full arithmetic first), 21.930,79? (N2 261.930,79 → 213.326,27+48.604,52? whatever — just read).
4. Grep for '197', '200326', '199326', duplicated rows, etc.
5. Fix whatever's off, rerun verification.
6. Report list of changes.

Let me batch the reads now: full parecer.md (from line 19), full parecer.json (lines 58+ rest), QUESTIONS full, STATUS full. Do parallel reads.

**Finding (a) — Lei 9.029/95**: IS in the library (INDEX line 8 cites the Lei 9.029/95; satisfaction). Citation is supported. The only soft spot is the md line 58 gloss "Lei 9.029/95 — veda a discriminação por gravidez": the library file only lists the Lei in the citation line without describing its content. INDEX "Citation" column just lists it too. The gloss "veda a discriminação por gravidez" is content not stated in the library. Options: keep the citation, but rephrase to only what the library affirms. Minimal edit: "…; Lei 9.029/95 — veda a discriminação por gravidez" → "…; Lei 9.029/95 — constante da biblioteca como fonte (texto do dispositivo não transcrito)". Hmm, but that's vague. Do I really need to strip it? Let me think about what a careful reviewer would do. The mandate: "unsupported authority". Library cites Lei 9.029/95 as an authority for gestante stability. The gloss describes what that law is about. The library's own title for the next file... Hmm. INDEX gives no description of the Lei's content. Real Lei 9.029/95 art. 1º/2º prohibits discrimination for pregnancy (and art. 4º the crime) — but that external knowledge isn't citable. The gloss is a fair reading of the Lei's title/purpose, but strictly not library text. Given the review's explicit instruction "unsupported authority" — the safest and cheap fix: adjust line 58's gloss to note it's "[fonte citada na biblioteca; literalidade do dispositivo não transcrita]". Also line 60 "(Lei 9.029/95)" bare citation — keep (it's just pointing to the authority that IS in the library); no change needed there. Actually for line 60 the phrase is "dispensa daqui em diante seria ainda mais indefensável (Lei 9.029/95)" — this uses the Lei as supporting why a future dispensa is indefensible (as an anti-discrimination rule). That's a plausible use consistent with the gloss — but again its content isn't in library. It's a citation to a statute that IS in the library index, so the citation is allowed. I'll keep line 60 and JSON line 20 and §9 line 161 as-is.

For line 58, I'll soften the gloss: "e a biblioteca cita Lei 9.029/95 (seu teor específico não transcrito no arquivo)". Actually keep it crisper: "; Lei 9.029/95 (citada na biblioteca — vedação de discriminação; texto não transposto)". Hmm — "vedação de discriminação" is still a gloss. If I keep any gloss I assert content. Simplest compliant phrasing: "; e a Lei 9.029/95 consta como fonte na biblioteca (sem texto de dispositivo no arquivo)". The gloss removed. But readability suffers slightly. I think it's worth it — pre-delivery review should be strict.

Wait, actually, let me reconsider: is it plausible the library intends the Lei as support for exactly that? The library file is about gestante stability; Lei 9.029/95 is the anti-pregnancy-discrimination statute; any reader knows its role. The gloss "veda a discriminação por gravidez" is essentially describing the statute's known subject matter — same as describing CLT 482 "k" as "ato lesivo da honra" (which IS transcribed). The difference: 482's text is transcribed; the Lei's is not. Pre-delivery rigor → make the gloss explicitly derivative. I'll do a minimal, surgical edit.

**Finding (b) — off-by-one date**: 11 occurrences → fix all to 23/09/2027 / "2027-09-23":
- md lines 59, 88, 133, 152, 199 (5 spots)
- json line 21 ("ate"), 60, 93 (3 spots)
- QUESTIONS line 18

**Finding (c) — topo da faixa claim** (md line 182): add explicit "não verificado" label for the displacement claim. Rewrite bullet:
Current: "- Risco agravado em reversão: dispensa punitiva de **crítica verdadeira** pode deslocar o dano moral para o topo da faixa de R$ 5–20 mil (verbas_reversao). O valor central do JSON (~R$ 15 mil) **não foi alterado** — essa ponderação não é demonstrável aritmeticamente."
New: "- Risco agravado em reversão: a biblioteca fixa o dano moral por imputação de falta grave inexistente (R$ 5–20 mil; `verbas_reversao.md`). Que a dispensa punitiva de **crítica verdadeira** desloque a fixação para o **topo** da faixa é ponderação deste parecer, **não constante da biblioteca — não verificado**. O valor central do JSON (~R$ 15 mil) **não foi alterado** — essa ponderação não é verificada nem demonstrável aritmeticamente."

Also check similar phrasing elsewhere: QUESTIONS line 10 "reforça parecer.md §3.3 e o risco de dano moral em reversão" — generic, OK. JSON line 75 same generic — OK. STATUS line 14 same — OK. Any other place with "topo"? grep later.

**Finding (d) — §5.2 breakdown**: line 89 "Período: 12/10/2026 → 02/06/2028 = 19 meses completos (nov/2026–mai/2028) + 22 dias." — verify arithmetic: 19 full calendar months Nov/2026–May/2028; 22 dias = 20 dias de out/2026 (12–31) + 2 dias de jun/2028 (1–2). Add the breakdown for clarity: "Período: 12/10/2026 → 02/06/2028 (do dia seguinte à dispensa até o fim da garantia) = 19 meses completos (nov/2026–mai/2028) + 22 dias restantes (20 dias de out/2026, de 12 a 31/10, e 2 dias de jun/2028)." "*Regras de fração aplicadas na tabela: 13º — fração de mês conta apenas com ≥ 15 dias (out/2026 tem 11 dias, não conta; jan–set completos = 9/12); férias — 6 meses completos de 15/03→15/09/2026 mais fração de 26 dias (15/09→11/10) que, por completar ≥ 15 dias, conta como 1 mês → 7/12; salário-dia sobre divisor de 30 dias. A biblioteca lista as verbas sem detalhar frações nem divisores — regras usuais aplicadas por este parecer (não verificadas nela); parâmetro recalculável*

Art. 146/147: fração superior a 14 dias conta como mês. Yes, ≥15 days → 1 month. And 13º: art. 17 §2º idem. So both correct in real law; but library doesn't transcribe them. So flag as "regras usuais ... (não verificadas nela)". That's honest and safe. Note that line 79 currently states "(out/2026 = 11 dias < 15 → não conta)" as before — with the new note the assertion gets its support label. Keep line 79 as-is.

Also should I flag "40 × 44.824,00 = 17.929,60" — multa 40% supported by library ✓; base estimate is (P)-labeled ✓. And "aviso 30 + 3×5" supported "(30 + 3/ano)" ✓.

- Dano moral CLT 223-G: leve 3 salários = 23.400; média 5 = 39.000; grave 20 = 156.000 ✓ (223-G: up to 3/50/500? NO WAIT — real CLT 223-G: ofensa leve até 3 salários, média até 50, grave até 500!! Actually real art. 223-G: (a) ofensa leve, indenizada até 3× salário; (b) média até 50×; (c) grave até 500×. Hmm!! That's real law: 3, 50, 500. But the LIBRARY says: "CLT 223-G: até 3 salários para ofensa leve, 5 média, 20 grave" and gives the faixa R$ 5–20 mil. The library is the sole authority here — even if real law differs, we must follow the library: 3/5/20 salários → 23.400/39.000/156.000. The md line 94 reflects the library faithfully ✓.
